tenderSchedule.title: Y FOR TRANSPORTATION OF COAL FROM WCL to RTPS by RCR
tenderSchedule.description: FOR APPOINTMENT OF COAL TRANSPORTATION AGENCY FOR TRANSPORTATION OF COAL FROM WCL OCMs TO NEAREST AVAILABLE WCL SIDING / RAILWAY GOOD SHED SIDING & LOADING IN INDIAN RAILWAY WAGONS FOR ONWARD TRANSPORTATION TO RAICHUR THERMAL POWER STATION (RTPS), RAICHUR, KARNATAKA BY ROAD CUM RAIL ROUTE
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Chief Engineer Mines office Bengaluru

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per the tender document
All bidders are requested to quote their basic rates in Rs./MT for each item of the price schedule (exclusive of GST)
All bidders are requested to indicate relevant GST in percentage in appropriate place/window/fields for each item of price schedule in KPPP
All bidders are requested to peruse the tender document completely before submitting their bid/offer

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: a)The tenderer should have previous experience with State / Central GENCOS for the work of coal transportation through Road cum Rail mode (i.e., Liaisoning with Coal Companies, Coal lifting, Road Transportation, identification and coordination of Railway Loading Siding(s), Railway Coordination, Loading Supervision, Movement, Handling and Delivery of Coal to TPSs) and have satisfactorily handled at least a minimum quantity of 2.5 Lakh MTs of coal & contract value not less than Rs. 8.75 crores in any one (1) financial year during the preceding five (5) financial years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work experience certificates along with relevant work orders/contract agreements

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: c)The tenderer should be financially sound and capable of executing high value contracts. As a proof of their financial capability, they should produce a firm and unconditional Letter of Commitment for an amount of Rs. 4.38 Crores (Rupees Four Crore Thirty Eight Lakhs Only) from any nationalized bank / scheduled bank / branches of foreign banks in India valid for minimum period of one year to meet the fund requirement of the contract

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Letter of Commitment from the bank as per the proforma provided in the tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: b)The tenderer should have achieved a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs. 35 crores in at least two financial years in last five years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 and shall furnish copies of profit & loss statements and Audited Balance sheets duly certified by the Chartered Accountant.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Profit and Loss statements and audited balance sheets duly certified by Chartered Accountant

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: d)Certificate of registration issued by Regional Deputy Director of Geology and Mines under section 23 of the Mines and Mineral (Prevention of illegal mining, transportation and storage) rules 2001.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevent Documents shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: e)The tenderer should have tied up with Railway sidings (Good shed/ Private siding) approved for dispatch of coal and submit permission/ Consent/ NOC from railway siding (Good shed/Private siding) for the same The siding should be available for the entire period of the contract dedicatedly for KPCL

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevent Documents shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: f)The Tenderer should submit consent letter/ Certificate from State pollution Control Board for handling/ storage of coal adjourning location to the offered Railway Siding.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevent Documents shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: g)The Tenderer shall submit a valid Certificate issued by the State Transport Authority or Regional Transport Authority (RTA) under the Carriage by Road Act, 2007 and the Carriage by Road Rules, 2011, authorizing the Tenderer to operate as a Transport Agency.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevent Documents shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: h)The tenderer must have ownership / working arrangement with a third party for a minimum of 25 Tippers/ Dumpers/ Trucks of GPS fitted with minimum coal carrying Capacity of 30 MT, each having Valid Registration Certificate, Updated Road Permit & Updated Fitness Certificate, (Ownership/ working arrangement documentary evidence to be submitted with bid documents)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevent Documents shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: i)The tenderer must have ownership / working arrangement with a third party for minimum 02 Pay Loaders (bucket capacity not less than 2.5 CuM) (Ownership/ working arrangement documentary evidence to be submitted with bid documents).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevent Documents shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: j)The tenderer shall furnish documentary evidence in the form of certificates issued by the General Manager / Chief Engineer / Head of the Company / Electricity Board / KPCL / CIL or their subsidiaries / WCL or their subsidiaries / any Thermal Power Station as proof of satisfactorily fulfilling the requirements indicated in 3.2(a) above along with the copies of the relevant work orders. In case of certificates issued by any person other than the above authorities, the head of the Company / Utility / CIL / WCL and their subsidiaries shall certify that the person issuing certificate is the authorized authority to issue such certificate.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevent Documents shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: k)The details regarding availability of transportation vehicles / tippers, coal loading machinery at the railway siding / stack yard for loading of coal into wagons, their capacity etc. The details shall be furnished as per Schedule-I. KPCL will have the right to inspect all the equipments / vehicles offered by the Tenderer and verify their ownership / control as well as their present working condition and other details if considered necessary before deciding the tender and awarding the work

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevent Documents shall be furnished

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All documents required under PQR and other conditions of the tender

itemList.itemName: Service charge for supervision of loading of Coal and monitoring the movement of Coal rakes in Rs./MT
Service charge for liaisoning with Coal company and Railways in Rs./MT
Loading at mines & Unloading at Stackyard and loading of coal into Railway rakes in Rs./MT
Transportation of coal by road from WCL OCMs to nearest Railway Siding in Rs./MT/Km
